text:
maya_cs: Hey team, quick heads-up — Finlytics onboarding is hitting a noisy warmup. Their Node SDK spawns ~50 workers during init and the gateway returned a mix of 503s and 429s during the first few minutes. Sharing logs below.

maya_cs: ```
POST /v1/generate 503 Service Unavailable
X-Request-Id: rq_abc123
X-RW-Node: gateway-7
---
POST /v1/generate 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
Retry-After: 10
````

tara_devex: can you paste the SDK init snippet they run and which key they used? also did they use connection pooling or the default?

maya_cs: snippet from their init (they're using our node sdk v0.9.2):

maya_cs: ```js
const rw = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new rw.Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, workers: 50, maxConcurrency: 20 });
await client.init();
// then they immediately fan out ~200 requests within 30s
```

luke_eng: thanks — pattern matches a warmup spike where the gateway sees sudden multiplexed handshakes and backend pool scaling lags. Gateway will 503 if no healthy backend is ready; 429 appears when per-key concurrency or burst bucket is exhausted.

luke_eng: short fixes: reduce client-side workers to 8-12, add jittered exponential backoff on 503/429, and stagger startup fanout. On our side we can increase the short-term burst quota for that key while they warm up (temp policy) and pre-warm additional pods in the dedicated pool.

luke_eng: config knobs we recommend they use: `workers: 8`, `maxConcurrency: 6`, and `handshakeConcurrency: 4` (if using our advanced options).

infra-bot: [autoscaler] detected scaling event for dedicated-pool-finlytics: nodes 0 -> 2 at 1955554350, reason: burst-latency.

maya_cs: ok i'm going to propose a 1-week warmup plan to the customer: step down workers -> ramp traffic -> we'll temporarily raise burst quota for their key -> monitor token and latency metrics. can engineering flip the burst policy for key finlytics-01?

luke_eng: I can apply a temporary burst increase (policy id: bp-temp-finlytics) for 72h. I'll also add a short-term rule to route their traffic to the warmup lane to avoid impacting other customers.

paul_csm: tagging this as potential renewal risk if we can't stabilize within 3 business days — please keep me updated.

tara_devex: i'll send a quick PR with a recommended sdk-init snippet and a sample backoff wrapper they can drop in. also offering a 30-min pairing session tomorrow to help them throttle startup.

maya_cs: thanks all — scheduling call for 09:30 PT tomorrow, sending invite. I'll include the logs + recommended snippet. :thumbsup:

luke_eng: noted. Also adding a small server-side metric to watch: `handshake_fail_rate` per key so we can alert earlier if this repeats.

maya_cs: cool, closing loop here for now. will post follow-ups after the call. :white_check_mark:
